verdict.rationale: The official Crossplane CLI says it can test and render standalone Composition Functions without access to a Kubernetes cluster running Crossplane. That lets developers validate composition logic locally, away from production. This is a single brief docs mention, though: it does not show how to write automated test cases, make assertions, or wire tests into CI, and it covers only Composition Functions rather than infrastructure code generally. Missing for 10: a documented test-authoring framework with assertions, CI integration guidance, testing coverage beyond Composition Functions (e.g. managed resources or provider behavior), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
